profile_headline: Social Media Marketer & Online brand building consultant
post_content:
"Oh, so you work from home at your own time. So lucky" is one phrase every
freelancer must have heard at some point or the other. Well, the grass is
always greener on the other side. Here are the top 3 problems I face and how I
tackle them: 1) Free time? A lot of people assume that freelancers have a lot
of free time in hand. But what they don't realise is that this free time is
constantly used to reach out to more clients and grow ~ Just 1 day off per
week is not enough. Ensure you have some time for yourself everyday. It is all
about work/life balance. 2) Social life? While people at offices or any other
workplace constantly interact with people around them, all our communications
happen through calls, mails or texts, most of the time. The lack of
communicating with people and having a work environment can lead to us feeling
low & lonely ~ No matter how busy you are, plan a day out with your friends
every week! Trust me on this one, socialising is important. 3) Body aches?
Yessss. While working at home, we tend to find comfortable spots to slouch in
and work. Back/shoulder/neck pain, wrist uneasiness and other body aches are
common among us due to bad posture. ~ Find a spot with good seating posture &
also stretch every few hours! Feel free to add on to this list :)
